Mountain Dwarf|Dwarven Armor Training: Proficiency with light and medium armor.
High Elf|Cantrip: One cantrip from the wizard list; Intelligence is its casting ability.
Wood Elf|Mask of the Wild: You can try to hide when only lightly obscured by natural phenomena such as foliage, rain or mist.
Drow|Sunlight Sensitivity: Disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Perception checks in direct sunlight.
Drow|Drow Magic: Dancing Lights cantrip; Faerie Fire from 3rd level and Darkness from 5th level, each once per long rest (Charisma).
Drow|Drow Weapon Training: Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords and hand crossbows.
Stout|Stout Resilience: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.
Variant Human|Skills: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.
